result.question: Qual o total e o percentual de internações por doenças respiratórias (CID J%) em cada trimestre do ano no estado do RS?
result.gold_sql: SELECT t.trimestre, COUNT(*) AS total_respiratorio, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS pct_anual FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d JOIN tempo t ON i."DT_INTER" = t.data WHERE i."DIAG_PRINC" LIKE 'J%' AND mu.estado = 'RS' GROUP BY t.trimestre ORDER BY t.trimestre;
result.generated_sql: WITH total_internacoes AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado = 'RS' ), internacoes_respiratorias AS ( SELECT EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM "DT_INTER") AS trimestre, c."CD_DESCRICAO" AS diagnostico, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i JOIN cid c ON i."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado = 'RS' AND c."CID" LIKE 'J%' GROUP BY trimestre, c."CD_DESCRICAO" ) SELECT ir.trimestre, ir.diagnostico, ir.total_internacoes, ROUND(ir.total_internacoes * 100.0 / ti.total, 2) AS proporcao FROM internacoes_respiratorias ir, total_internacoes ti ORDER BY ir.trimestre, ir.diagnostico;
